category: 组合数学 / 计数组合
literal_source_claim_en: A lower bound for sumsets and product sets.
statement_blocker: The catalog omits the domain, nonzero premise, exponent, constant, ordered binders, cardinality casts, and boundary cases. The exact 1997 candidate is located, but the repository does not cite or adopt it, correction and errata status is not accepted, and no independent reviewer has approved the crosswalk. Freezing a canonical root during intake would manufacture acceptance.
domain_and_universes: Candidate source domain: one finite subset A of the nonzero real numbers. The intended Lean carrier is Finset Real in Type, but the finite-set representation, decidability implementation, and any checked Set/Finset transports remain open for statement freeze.
conclusion: Candidate source conclusion: one positive absolute real constant c works for every source-domain A, with c times |A| to the real power 5/4 at most the maximum of the two pairwise-set cardinalities. This is not yet the accepted canonical conclusion.
degenerate_case_status: No case is canonically excluded at intake. Source review must decide the empty set under the standing convention and proof's positive-incidence parameters, verify the singleton case, preserve the exclusion of zero, and account for negative elements and repeated pairwise values.
